The vendor and developer directly providing the software platform **Transpocket** at **transpocket.com** is **TransPocket**, created and published by the developer **Midori Glow** (**MidoriGlow**).

### Evidence:
* **Operating Company / Provider:** Company profiles identify **TransPocket** as the operating provider based in Singapore: 
  > *"TransPocket is an unfunded company based in Singapore (Singapore), founded in 2025. It operates as a Provider of AI-powered platform converting audio and video files to text... Website: transpocket.com."*
  > AlternativeTo similarly lists the developer as *"Transpocket"* (Singapore) for the official website `transpocket.com`.
* **Published Developer:** Developer and launch platforms (DevHunt and Peerlist) list the maker/developer directly providing the project as **Midori Glow** / **@MidoriGlow**:
  > *"The maker. MidoriGlow. @MidoriGlow · launched TransPocket..."*
  > *"Transpocket ... Midori Glow ... TransPocket was built to solve the pain of expensive, slow audio transcription services."*
